`sample.heic` is the HEVC test image from the libheif project's `examples` directory:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic

The upstream directory's MIT license is reproduced in `libheif-examples-LICENSE.txt`.
The fixture exercises real HEVC decoding with Sharp's standard prebuilt binaries,
multiple embedded images, and browser uploads with missing MIME types. It is never
included in public assets.
